recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future hierarchy or renderer change again separates RDF from the other syntax pages.
issue_request: FHIR-18458 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request from fhir-i asking that RDF use the same breadcrumb path as XML and JSON instead of appearing under Exchange.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-18458. Jira records Grahame Grieve's 2018-11-08 comment that the change was already done, and the adjacent Jira-tagged commit 6f0d5f1f9d633d6a516658d115bb14e5bd0a0e9f for FHIR-18459 had already moved rdf.html from the Exchange module into the same Formats group as xml.html, json.html, and nd-json.html.
additional_context: Current hierarchy source keeps RDF, XML, JSON, and NDJSON together under Foundation > Documentation > Resource Definitions, while current build.fhir.org breadcrumbs show RDF, XML, and JSON all using Foundation > Documentation Index > Resource Definitions. The adjacent FHIR-18459 audit is already present on the combined branch, and community searches found no later conflicting RDF breadcrumb decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk is needed because current active source and the rendered specification already satisfy the seed request.
